_meta.description: Shows outside the opening window whose hidden scored review files were investigated and accepted (e.g. syndicated duplicate text, a mis-dated review the late-date guard rightly drops). check-review-count-drift.js alerts only on a show that is dark or hides more than the threshold AND has a hidden file NOT listed here. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-review-count-drift.js --update-baseline, then review the diff.
